name: Abhyas - Merged Collection (Travel Time + Flow + Incidents, indiranagar_cmh)

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Two rules = 65 executions/day, matching the original collection's observed cadence (06:00-22:00, 15 min apart, last one at 22:00 only).

nodes.name: Set Points
Calculate Route (TomTom)
nodes.notes: Create your OWN Query Auth credential here with YOUR OWN TomTom API key (not the shared one), so this account draws against its own separate 2,500/day TomTom quota.

nodes.name: Append to Sheet
nodes.notes: Column names must match your existing sheet exactly: move_id, junction, movement, orig, dest, observed_utc, observed_ist, lengthInMeters, travelTimeInSeconds, historicTravelTimeInSeconds, noTrafficTravelTimeInSeconds, trafficDelayInSeconds, departureTime, error, http_status

nodes.name: Get Flow Segment Data (TomTom)
nodes.notes: Reuses the same queryAuth credential as Calculate Route - same key, same 2500/day quota, just one more call per point.

nodes.name: Append to FlowSegments Sheet
nodes.notes: Create a FlowSegments tab with headers: move_id, junction, movement, point, fetched_at_utc, fetched_at_ist, frc, currentSpeed, freeFlowSpeed, currentTravelTime, freeFlowTravelTime, confidence, roadClosure, error

nodes.name: Set Junctions
Append to Obstructions
nodes.notes: Point at the same spreadsheet as Append to Sheet1 (All Incidents), just a different tab: Obstructions.
